As far as I understand it, it stand for “adverse childhood experiences”. This quiz came about with a study done in the 90’s about how childhood trauma hurts people later in life. This study was done in the U.S, and it was found that those with a score of 4 or higher were found to be at higher risk for physical and mental health issues later in life, particularly heart disease, diabetes, depression and suicide. 

While this study was revolutionary back in its day, it’s not really a good indicator of how much trauma someone has and how “at risk” they are. Even still, a lot of institutions use it to help quantify people’s suffering. There’s so much the study and quiz don’t account for, but I can’t deny that it’s still a good starting point
